params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: Choosing the file name for a platform copy asks S3 for a folder listing on every copy, and on 2026-11-24 one listing did not answer, so the copy stopped with an unhandled `UnableToCheckDirectoryExistence` (Nightwatch #79). Same shape as rule R S1-6.38, in a place its test did not see.

## What happened

On 2026-11-24 at 14:56 UTC (one occurrence) production threw:

> League\Flysystem\UnableToCheckDirectoryExistence: Unable to check existence for: 24182/stocklist_car_image_7.jpg

at `app/Support/PhotoNames.php:24`.

## Why

`PhotoNames::free()` picks the name of a platform copy (`stocklist_car_image_N.jpg`, then `(1)`, `(2)`). It asks `Storage::disk($disk)->exists($path)`. On S3, `exists()` means "a file OR a folder": a HEAD, and when that finds nothing, a `ListObjectsV2` over the prefix. A free name is the usual case, so every copy runs a folder listing. This time the listing did not answer and the exception went up unhandled.

R S1-6.38 already forbids `exists` on the bucket, and `TheBucketIsNotAskedForADirectoryTest` checks for it. But the test only looks for the literal `disk('vehicles')->exists(`, and this call names the disk through a variable.

`PhotoNames::free` is called from `PlatformPhotoService::duplicate` (the Stocklist checkbox, saving a vehicle, `stocklist:platform-photos`) and `Photo::createStockListPhotoFromPhoto` (the partner API). Nightwatch does not say which caller this was.

## Not the same as #1012

#1012 / #1116 is about a write the bucket refused in `ProcessVehiclePhoto`. This is a needless listing in another place. A slow bucket is the trigger both times, but the fix is different.

## Fix

- `PhotoNames::free` asks each name with `fileExists` (one HEAD), asked again once when the bucket does not answer (`StorageUnavailable::retryOnce`).
- The rule test also catches `exists(`/`missing(` on `backgrounds`, `dealers` and on a disk passed in a variable.

Source: Portal mail:66 (a forwarded Nightwatch notification).
params.title: Choosing a platform copy's name lists the vehicle's folder on S3 (Nightwatch #79)
